scope: deployment validation, independent approval, gray expansion, exact rule/model ACK gate, rollback-target preservation and evidence export

enablement_order: deployment runtime ACK gate for an authorized canary

invariants: precheck discovers receipt event IDs from immutable deployment rule/model versions instead of trusting a browser payload
approval freezes exact rule and model receipt event IDs and expected parallelism
partial, failed, pending or missing rule/model ACK sets stop gray start
a newer event after approval requires a new precheck and independent approval
full activation requires the approved rule/model receipts plus the gray_started broker projection receipt
an enabled runtime gate forbids planned-to-active bypass of gray observation
workbench and exported evidence expose the same live runtime gate
recoverable deployment rows and their immutable rule/model version references are not deleted

ui_contract.expansion_control: continue gray is disabled only for gray deployments whose enabled gate has expansion_allowed=false
ui_contract.default_off_message: does not claim runtime completion while the gate is disabled

open_items: authorize and observe a non-zero production candidate before enabling the runtime gate
prove broker-generated rule and model ACK delivery for the exact deployment candidate
orchestrate dedicated rule/model rollback commands and collect fresh rollback ACKs before changing the deployment active pointer
run performance, failure-injection and formal rollback drills
complete Windows Chrome review and the production observation window
